# UniversalDataWriter

## Description

Receives data through the connected input port and writes the records to delimited or fixed-length flat files (CSV, fixed-length, or mixed) — local or remote. The output **format is defined by the input metadata** (its field/record delimiters or fixed widths), not by an attribute. It is a sink at the end of a graph, with an optional output port for port-writing. Supports partitioning into many files, compression, header rows, and quoting. **UniversalDataWriter is the `DATA_WRITER` alias of FlatFileWriter (`FLAT_FILE_WRITER`)** — the same component under both names; it is the standard choice for generic flat-file export. For CloverDX-native binary output use **CloverDataWriter** (`CLOVER_WRITER`).

## Purpose & when to use

Reach for DATA_WRITER when:

- You need to export records to **flat files** — CSV / delimited, fixed-length, or mixed — including remote targets, compressed outputs, partitioned files, output ports, or dictionaries.

Don't use it when:

- The target is CloverDX binary `.cdf` → use **CloverDataWriter** (`CLOVER_WRITER`).
- The target is a spreadsheet / JSON / XML / Parquet → use the format-native writer.

## XML template

```xml
<Node id="UDW0" type="DATA_WRITER"
      fileURL="${DATAOUT_DIR}/out.csv"
      guiName="UniversalDataWriter" guiX="600" guiY="200">
  <!-- optional: charset, append (false), quotedStrings, quoteCharacter,
       makeDirs (false), outputFieldNames (false|true|force),
       recordsPerFile, bytesPerFile, recordSkip, recordCount, excludeFields,
       createEmptyFiles (true), skipLastRecordDelimiter (false),
       partitionKey, partition, partitionFileTag (numberFileTag|keyNameFileTag),
       partitionOutFields, partitionUnassignedFileName, sortedInput (false) -->
</Node>
```

- `type="DATA_WRITER"`.
- Mandatory: `fileURL`.
- `fileURL` supports local/remote (`ftp:`/`sftp:`/…), zip/gzip, an output port (`port:$0.field`), and dictionaries.
- No CTL2 — the output format comes from the **input** metadata.

## Properties

**Basic**

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fileURL` | file | **required** | Path or URL of the file to write (primary attribute; also accepts an output port or dictionary). |
| `charset` | charset | (encoder default) | Character encoding used to encode file content. |
| `append` | bool | `false` | When enabled, appends to the existing output file instead of overwriting it. |
| `quotedStrings` | bool | (from input metadata) | Enables quoting of string values in delimited files, so strings can contain delimiter characters. |
| `quoteCharacter` | writerQuoteChar | (from input metadata) | Character used to quote string values when `quotedStrings` is enabled. |

**Advanced**

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `makeDirs` | bool | `false` | Create the target directory structure if it doesn't exist. |
| `outputFieldNames` | enum | `false` | Write a header row of field names as the first line: `false` (No), `true` (Yes), `force` (Force). |
| `recordsPerFile` | int | — | Maximum records written to each output file before starting a new file. |
| `bytesPerFile` | int | — | Maximum size of each output file in bytes before starting a new file. |
| `recordSkip` | int | — | Number of records to skip before starting to write. |
| `recordCount` | int | — | Maximum number of records to write. |
| `excludeFields` | key | — | Input fields to omit from the output (`;`-separated). |
| `partitionKey` | key | — | Key fields used to partition data into separate output files by field value. Required together with `partition` when partitioning by lookup. |
| `partition` | lookupTableID | — | Lookup table used for partitioning data into different output files. Required together with `partitionOutFields`. |
| `partitionFileTag` | enum | `numberFileTag` | How partitioned output files are named: `numberFileTag` (numbered) or `keyNameFileTag` (named by key value). |
| `partitionOutFields` | key | — | Lookup-table fields whose values name the output files. Required together with `partition`. |
| `partitionUnassignedFileName` | string | — | Filename for records that don't match any partition criteria. |
| `sortedInput` | bool | `false` | Indicates the input is already sorted, which can optimize partitioned writing (only the current file is kept open). |
| `createEmptyFiles` | bool | `true` | Create an output file even when there is no data to write. |
| `skipLastRecordDelimiter` | bool | `false` | Omit the record delimiter after the last record in each file. |

## Input & output metadata

One required input port (port 0) carries the records to write — and **its metadata defines the written format** (field/record delimiters or fixed widths). The optional output port 0 is a port-writing target whose shape you define (a single `string` / `byte` / `cbyte` field). The writer does not propagate metadata and has no engine template.

```
auto_propagated_metadata:   # none auto-supplied — the INPUT metadata defines the written format
  in.0:  <any — records to write; its delimiters / widths shape the output file>
  out.0: <you define — port-writing target (string | byte | cbyte field)>   # optional
```

Edges carry your data `<Metadata>` on the input port; an edge from the optional output port references your port-writing `<Metadata>`. Port counts: exactly 1 input, 0–1 output.
